fee_details:
-For 1st year: Rs.1,000 + applicable taxes
-For 2nd Year onwards: Rs.1,000 + applicable taxes
-Rs. 200/- waived on completing 2 transactions in a month for first 3 consecutive months
joining_perks: Welcome gift of Rs. 1,000 cash points applicable on paying membership fee only
reward_structure:
-Shopping on Paytm/ShopClues: 5% cashback on spends of Rs. 2,000
-Online spends: 2.5% cashback on spends of Rs. 2,000
-Offline spends (exclud wallet): 1% cashback on spends of Rs. 100
key_highlights:
-Cashback of 0.5% can be availed by cardholders on various online brands, such as Amazon, Swiggy, SonyLiv, Tata Cliq, BookMyShow, Flipkart, Myntra, Uber and Zomato.
-Cardholders can avail 1% cashback on other spends (excluding wallet transactions and EMI).
-Using HDFC Bank Millennia credit card on tenure based spends will provide 20% off on restaurant bills.

benefits_features.Fuel benefits: Fuel surcharge waiver is capped at Rs.200 for a minimum transaction amount of Rs.400 to Rs.5000 respectively
benefits_features.Renewal benefits: Cardholders can avail renewal of membership in next year for spending Rs. 1 Lakh or more in the previous year

how_tos.How to Redeem Cashback:
The cashback that you earn can be accumulated and redeemed as CashPoints against the statement balance.
-One CashPoint will be equivalent to Rs.1 and you will need to accumulate at least 500 CashPoints to redeem.
-You can redeem your CashPoints against Rewards Catalogue and flight booking, at a value of 1 CashPoint = Rs.1( +Rs.250). 
-The CashPoints must be redeemed before 1 year of accumulation
how_tos.Net Banking:
1. Net banking
   a. Log into your internet banking account using your credentials (user ID/password)
   b. After logging in, click on the credit card option
   c. Register your credit card
   d. Click on "Register New Card"
   e. Enter your eight-digit credit card PIN to complete the registration process
   f. Click on "Redeem Reward Points" link to redeem your cash points
   g. If your card is already registered, then select your card and click on "Continue"
   h. On the homepage, click on "Redeem Reward Points"
   i. Select the point range
   j. View catalogue to select the product
   k. Add the products from shopping cart
   l. Redeem your cash points during checkout
how_tos.Post:
1. Download the Reward Redemption Form online
   2.Fill in the redemption form
   3.Post the form to the mailing address mentioned by HDFC Bank
